::: {#thm-ref}
A theorem.
:::

@thm-ref begins a line.
In parentheses (@thm-ref) and before a full stop: @thm-ref.
Before a colon @thm-ref: and a comma @thm-ref, too.
In *emphasis @thm-ref* and **strong @thm-ref**.
In [a link to @thm-ref](https://example.org/) the reference is text.
Not in an address: someone@thm-ref.example, nor a citation [@thm-ref], nor <https://example.org/@thm-ref>.
Nor in `@thm-ref` code, nor $@thm$ math.
Unknown prefixes are not references: @smith2020, @foo-bar.

## Section with @thm-ref in its heading
